title: PolicyTransition
description: Formal schema for certified operating mode transitions: O_t -> certified condition -> mode transition -> G_{t+1}.

transition_id.description: Unique identifier for this certified policy transition.

profile_id.description: Identifier of the active SystemDesignProfile governing the transition.

profile_version.description: Semantic version of the governing SystemDesignProfile.

trigger_id.description: Reference ID to observation_id, trigger rule, or command.

condition_matched.description: Formal predicate that evaluated to True.

observed_value.description: Telemetry value or state attribute that triggered the match.

confidence.description: Observation confidence at time of evaluation.

evaluated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of governance evaluation.

causal_epoch.description: Monotonically increasing sequence epoch at transition time.

certified_by.description: Authority identity (kernel certifier / governance node) that evaluated and certified the transition.

witness_hash.description: SHA-256 hash linking this transition to the Evidence Ledger.
